title: Shaping and Monitoring Models Through Their Internal Representations
summary: We currently reward AI models for succeeding in training, but don’t specify how they should get there – leading to misgeneralization and misalignment. Our latest paper introduces mechanistic shaping, a way to teach models to be “right for the right reasons”, and studies its effects on monitorability.

title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
Clearing up a robot’s fuzzy memory
summary: A new system identifies and corrects unreliable object descriptions stored in a robot’s memory, improving the robot’s ability to interact with its environment.
